previousRule: Cushion quoting rejects every fabric whose lifecycle is not CURRENT before looking up its verified supplier cost or recent stock. The curtain pricing path can calculate a price for an UNKNOWN lifecycle fabric when commercial evidence is verified. My Home renders a neutral cushion even when the selected calibrated artwork is available.
newRule: Use the existing shared Fabric Master price-eligibility rule for cushion catalogue and quote lookup. Known discontinued or noncommercial fabrics remain blocked. An UNKNOWN lifecycle fabric may receive a binding cushion quote only when exact-identity supplier cost, fresh available stock, cutting, construction, insert and dispatch evidence all pass. Render selected calibrated fabric artwork in My Home without changing the saved specification; label a neutral fallback clearly.
reason: Amalfi Herb and Acies Amethyst have VERIFIED price status and positive 14 October stock observations, while their lifecycle is UNKNOWN. Curtains can calculate a price, but Cushion Studio discards cost and stock before quoting. The owner showed another blocked cushion and requested that the live site, protected source and production configuration follow one reproducible rule.
ownerApprovedDecision: The owner requested reconciliation of these cushion flags with the existing shared commerce rule. This scoped rule alignment and selected-fabric preview are presented for the required Nylon1 exact-head approval before protected merge and live release.
